## Earnie 2.6.0-alpha.1

First community **pre-release** of the **2.6** HA-coupling line (follows official **2.5.3**). Do **not** continue `2.5.3-alpha.N` — pin this tag.

### Highlights

- **HA / EHAL-Com coupling (2.6.a–i)** — HouseSim mock bench, suggest-and-confirm binding, Pattern B on `house_profiles`, energy counters, entity-picker UX, HA secrets / Schreibtest, HouseSim S4 HA integration
- **2.6.r quality gate** — pulp pinned `<4`, KPI mega-file / function splits (`ui/charts`, planning window, MILP inputs, …), docs walk for Pattern B
- **Monitor Chart 2** — daily Kosten KPIs and Ersparnis-bisher line
- **Deviation fix** — false Zwangs-Entladen when discharge already ran

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0-alpha.1` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.3**).
